name: rate-limit-guard
description: Shared rate-limit guard for loop lanes and Claude: a hooks module writes the subscription rate-limit windows to a fixed machine-scope file and tells Claude where they stand at boundaries, a StopFailure hook records rate-limit stops reactively, and a reader contract fixes how consuming sessions pause and resume.

rate_limit_guard_enabled.title: Rate-limit stop hook and snapshot writes
rate_limit_guard_enabled.description: Turns on the StopFailure detection hook and the module's snapshot writes to the machine-scope rate-limit file. Lines to Claude have their own option. On by default. Read from managed settings first, then user settings.

rate_limit_lines_enabled.title: Rate-limit lines to Claude
rate_limit_lines_enabled.description: Sends Claude one line when a rate-limit window approaches or reaches the line threshold, when it resets, and after a compaction, a resume or a /clear at the threshold. On by default.

rate_limit_report_mode.title: Rate-limit report mode
rate_limit_report_mode.description: automatic (default) sends the lines to Claude; operator holds them in a turn a person typed and offers the person a ready-made prompt and a notice row above the prompt when the turn ends. Headless, loop and schedule turns get automatic lines either way.

rate_limit_line_threshold.title: Rate-limit line threshold (percent)
rate_limit_line_threshold.description: Window use at which Claude gets the threshold line, 1 to 100; any other value reads as the default. Default 95, the loop lanes' pause edge, which stays 95 whatever this is set to.

rate_limit_approach_pct.title: Rate-limit approach mark (percent)
rate_limit_approach_pct.description: Window use at which Claude gets one approach line before the threshold, 1 to 100; any other value reads as the default. Default 90; at or above the threshold, no approach line is sent.

rate_limit_line_data.title: Rate-limit line data
rate_limit_line_data.description: Comma list of what a line carries beside its verdict, which every line has: percent, window and reset. Default verdict,window,reset; a list with an unknown item reads as the default. Never the account email or the session name.

rate_limit_guard_band.title: Rate-limit band row
rate_limit_guard_band.description: Draws the 5-hour and 7-day window figures in a row above the prompt. Off by default. Turn it on in /config, or for one session with /rate-limit-guard band on.

rate_limit_guard_toast.title: Window-change toast
rate_limit_guard_toast.description: Shows a toast and writes one transcript line when a rate-limit window nears or reaches the line threshold, or resets from it. Off keeps the transcript line. On by default.
